name: Player Statistic
author: MickeyDisn
description: Player Statistic — event-driven KPI tracker. Counts structures placed/removed/moved, items used (vacuum, shoot, …), terrain dug, world-item pickups and resources collected. Configurable Home KPI cards. Select the tool to open the overlay; lock it to keep it open.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, the tool and overlay are not registered; event listeners are removed and storage is wiped.

persistSession.label: Persist session KPIs
persistSession.description: Keep session counters across game reloads. When off, session counters reset every load.

historyMax.label: History depth
historyMax.description: How many total-snapshot points to keep for sparklines (5–50).
